Hey Shir -don’t worry - the changes to the Utah marriage laws didn’t go through in the end 🙂 And in any case, it wouldn’t have affected marriages that already happened. 

And don’t stress about the 30 day report requirement either - it’s not really enforced, and PIBA understands that often it takes a while to get the apostille. You can try and submit the digital apostille if you like - theoretically PIBA should accept it, but it could cause some confusion because it’s not so common.
